t: Powerful detergent formulation cuts through ingrained grime, grease and algae to rejuvenate weathered timber decks ready for refinishing. Can also be used on newly-installed decking to remove pretreatments and prepare the wood for staining or other finishing, helping to increase the lifetime of the final treatment. Also suitable for use on composite decking and as a cleaner for exterior cladding.
b: For Use on Weathered or New Decking
